about.title: About the Unbroken Bonds set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Unbroken Bonds is a Sun & Moon expansion released on 3 May 2019. It has 234 cards: 214 in the main set and 20 secret rares. There are also 176 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 214 main set cards), the Master set (390 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 410 cards, adding the 20 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
